title: Owner approves an expert's store access
problem: Experts needed the owner's password or a support PIN to work in a store.
now: The owner approves a limited, timed access in the order; it opens a logged access session for the expert.
steps: In super admin, ask for store access on an order.
In the merchant panel, approve it.
Back in super admin, Start session.
notes: Where: My services › an order · Super admin › Services › an order
